alt: 台灣國小園遊會中，孩子表面參與布置活動，實際上一直注意餅乾攤位，露出別有用心的神情。
scene_prompt: 成語：採「表面上為了一件事，實際上另有目的」的意思，重點是行動的真正用意藏在另一件事後面。台灣國小園遊會，一名孩子表面上拿著小盤子品嚐同學做的餅乾，眼神卻偷偷望向旁邊需要幫忙布置的舞台，手裡還藏著彩帶；他其實是想邀請大家一起準備驚喜表演。老師與同學察覺後露出會意笑容。用眼神和雙重目的呈現，不出現文字數字或可讀標誌。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Characters: Taiwanese (East Asian) children and adults drawn in a gentle Japanese anime picture-book style, natural expressions, age-appropriate child proportions (elementary-school kids look 7-12 years old). Setting: present-day Taiwan (Taiwanese schools, streets, homes, parks). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy brown, generous ivory breathing room; no bright flat digital colors, no glossy 3D, no imitation of a named artist.
